description: Builds a ready-to-send intro message and a link the person opens to send it themselves (WhatsApp, email) or a booking link (Calendly). This server does not send the message. Do not put personal data (names, phone numbers, emails) in the summary. Conversations with this agent are kept for up to 12 months so Goce can improve it: the messages, the time, the app used and an approximate location (country, city, network). No IP addresses are stored.

channel.description: How the person wants to reach Goce: a WhatsApp or email link, or a Calendly booking link

language.description: Language of the message: English or French

project_type.description: The service that fits, by id from get_services, or other

summary.description: One or two sentences about the project, no personal data

name: request_intro
title: Draft an intro message
